A third-party indexed lead suggests a later Ordinance 1763, but its adopted text and relationship to this moratorium remain unverified. proposed_changes.after: The six-month moratorium adopted April 14, 2026 under Ordinance 1754 was replaced by permanent ESS regulations adopted October 13, 2026. Executed Ordinance 1763 section 11 terminates the moratorium upon the new ordinance’s effective date; section 16 and the clerk’s completed block record immediate effectiveness on October 13. Council minutes record AB26-73 approval 6-0. The replacement prohibits stationary utility-scale electrochemical energy storage systems in all zoning districts and regulates other systems. proposed_changes.after: Council approved permanent ESS regulations 6-0 on October 13, 2026. Executed Ordinance 1763 expressly terminated the Ordinance 1754 moratorium upon immediate effectiveness; stationary utility-scale EESS are prohibited in all zoning districts, while other ESS remain subject to specified standards and exceptions.
